'''''Star Wars: Darth Maul''''' is a series of comics published by [[Dark Horse Comics]] about [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul's]] mission to destroy [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun's]] leadership. It ran from September 6, [[2000]] to December 6, 2000.
